description: OnePlus Nord Buds 3r launched in a Jade Mist colour option in India. The new variant joins the existing Aura Blue and Ash Black finishes. The OnePlus Nord Buds 3r Jade Mist variant will be available in India from October 8, 2026. It is priced at Rs. 1,999. Shoppers can get it for an effective price of Rs. 1,599 with applicable bank offers and special price discounts.
title: OnePlus Nord Buds 3r Gets Jade Mist Colour Variant in India: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung's first clip-on earphones bring an open-ear design to the Galaxy Buds range, with the speaker and battery positioned around the ear instead of inside it. The Galaxy Buds On comes withTwinBoost speakers, Audio Leakage Reduction and automatic volume adjustment, while three microphones and a Voice Pickup Unit handle calls. It also supports Gemini Live, Quick Voice Memo and Head Gestures on compatible Galaxy AI devices. Samsung has not yet disclosed the driver configuration, Bluetooth version, codecs or detailed charging specifications.
title: Samsung Galaxy Buds On Unveiled With Clip-On Design, Up to 9.5 Hours of Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Samsung has launched the Galaxy A08 in India with a single 4GB RAM and 64GB storage configuration. The phone supports up to 2TB of additional storage via a microSD card and runs Android 16-based One UI 9. It will receive six generations of OS upgrades and six years of security updates. Other features include Samsung Knox, Circle to Search 3.0, Gemini and Perplexity, along with an IP64 rating and Gorilla Glass 5 protection.
title: Samsung Galaxy A08 Launched in India With MediaTek Helio G99+ SoC, 6,000mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Sony announced the PS Plus monthly games lineup for October, which includes F1 25, Hunt: Showdown 1896, and Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2, on the PlayStation Blog on Wednesday. Once added to PS Plus, the titles will be available to PS Plus Essential, Extra, and Deluxe/Premium tier members. The games will be available on the service till November 2.
title: F1 25, Hunt: Showdown 1896 and Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 Join PS Plus in October

description: The Samsung Galaxy Watch 9 retains Samsung's cushion-shaped design and comes with a bright 3,000-nit Super AMOLED display. The smartwatch runs on Qualcomm's Snapdragon Wear Elite platform and Wear OS 7 with Samsung's One UI Watch interface. It also brings new health features such as Vitals, Daily Cardio Load, Fitness Index, Heart Health Score, and improved sleep tracking. Check out the review to know more about Samsung's latest Galaxy Watch.
title: Samsung Galaxy Watch 9 Review: A Polished Upgrade

description: Nike has introduced the Apex. The latest footwear uses Air Zoom technology with a new ZoomX LT foam, a redesigned carbon-fibre Flyplate and a Flyknit X upper. Apex is said to deliver up to 40 percent more energy return than the Alphafly 3 in a men's size 10. It is confirmed to be available for purchase early next year. It will go on sale through Nike's official website and select retail stores.
title: Nike Apex Racing Shoe Launched With Double-Stacked Air Zoom Platform, Carbon Fibre Flyplate

description: Crypto hacks resulted in between $766 million (roughly Rs. 675 crore) and $768.4 million (roughly Rs. 677 crore) in losses during September, according to PeckShield and CertiK. Bitget’s $387.5 million (roughly Rs. 341 crore) breach and the $318.7 million (roughly Rs. 281 crore) Liquid Network exploit were the two largest incidents. CertiK recorded 97 security incidents during the month.
title: Crypto Hack Losses Reach $768 Million in September, Marking 2026’s Worst Month

description: The Lava Shark 2 Pro 5G, HMD Vibe 2 Pro 5G and Mivi One 5G target buyers looking for 5G phones around Rs. 15,000, but their specifications vary considerably. HMD offers the highest-resolution display, fastest charging and higher-resolution cameras, while Lava combines a 120Hz screen with a 6,000mAh battery and 2K video recording. Mivi starts at Rs. 14,999 and offers up to 8GB of RAM, stock Android 16 and expandable storage. Here is a closer look at their prices, specifications and features.
title: Lava Shark 2 Pro 5G vs HMD Vibe 2 Pro 5G vs Mivi One 5G: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has said that Microsoft's gaming division is not up for sale. Denying reports that claim Microsoft was considering spinning off Xbox, Sharma said the gaming unit had a "long way to go with Microsoft". Xbox recently announced a new round of layoffs and restructuring measures as part of its ongoing efforts to reset its business.
title: 'Xbox Is Not for Sale': CEO Asha Sharma Denies Microsoft Wants to Divest Struggling Gaming Unit

description: The Redmi 17C has barely changed over its predecessor, the Redmi 15C. The phone offers the same overall specifications as the previous model but is now available in new colourways and finishes. Oddly, given the ongoing memory crisis, this isn’t necessarily a problem.
title: Redmi 17C First Impressions

description: The Lumio Aura 5 will be available during the Amazon Great Indian Festival starting October 15. The Aura 5 gives the company a product that sits somewhere between the simplicity of a soundbar and the traditional appeal of a stereo speaker setup. Whether that approach can persuade consumers to look beyond the increasingly familiar soundbar remains to be seen. But Lumio is clearly betting that there is still room in the living room for a different kind of speaker.
title: Lumio Aura 5 Challenges the Soundbar Status Quo With a Different Approach to Home Audio

description: Oppo F35 Pro 5G and Oppo F35 5G have been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model numbers CPH2829 and CPH2931, respectively. The Pro model has been listed with the MediaTek MT6878 chipset, which is the MediaTek Dimensity 7360 SoC. The Oppo F35 Pro 5G is shown to feature four efficiency cores clocked at 2.0GHz and four performance cores, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.5GHz. The phone has been listed with 8GB of RAM and Android 17. The handset managed to score 850 points on Geekbench’s single-core performance and 2,971 points on the multi-core performance test. It might also feature an ARM Mali-G615 MC2 GPU.
title: Oppo F35 Pro 5G, Oppo F35 5G Appear on Geekbench With MediaTek Chipsets Ahead of India Launch

description: Google is initially testing Gemini 4 Argon with cybersecurity professionals through its Fairwind Program. The model has a 1-million-token output limit, compared with 64,000 previously, and Google reports scores of 77.9 percent on DeepSWE v1.1 and 91.7 percent on LVBench. Argon has also been used internally for projects involving quantum computing and codebase migrations. In cybersecurity testing, it scored 68 percent on CWE-bench v1. Google plans to expand access after testing its safeguards for potential misuse.
title: Google Announces Gemini 4 Argon With Longer Output Limit: See Features, Availability

description: India recorded $88.4 billion (roughly Rs. 8,50,042 crore) in cryptocurrency transactions through centralised exchanges between July 2025 and June 2026, according to Chainalysis. Singapore followed at $82.3 billion (roughly Rs. 7,92,055 crore), while Australia recorded $79.3 billion (roughly Rs. 7,63,183 crore). India’s overall crypto economy declined 14.7 percent during the period to $135 billion.
title: India Sees Stronger Centralised Crypto Exchange Inflows Than Singapore, Australia

description: A fake iPhone Duo preorder website is using the DarkSword exploit chain to target vulnerable iPhones, according to Malwarebytes. The malicious page can attempt to access device information, Apple Notes, saved credentials, and data linked to crypto wallets, including MetaMask, Phantom, and Trust Wallet. Apple has patched the vulnerabilities associated with the DarkSword attacks.
title: Fake iPhone Duo Pre-Order Site Targets Crypto Wallets With DarkSword Malware, Report Warns

description: Samsung Galaxy M08 and Galaxy F08 have been announced in India as the two new budget phones from the tech giant. The handsets are confirmed to go on sale in India via the Samsung online store in 4GB + 64GB RAM and storage configurations. Moreover, the Samsung Galaxy F08 and Galaxy M08 are offered in Dark Blue and Silver shades, respectively. The Samsung Galaxy M08 and Galaxy F08 are identical in technical specifications. The new dual-SIM phones ship with One UI 9, which is based on Android 17. The tech giant promises six OS upgrades and six years of security updates for the two handsets.
title: Samsung Galaxy F08, Galaxy M08 Announced in India With 50-Megapixel Rear Camera, Up to Six Years of OS Support: Specifications

description: Tinder has started rolling out Group Hangouts, which allows groups of friends to discover and match with other groups through the app. Groups can have different numbers of members and choose activities before appearing in Discovery. A mutual Like opens a shared chat where participants can make plans to meet. The feature is currently available in the US and select markets. Tinder has also added controls for leaving group chats, blocking or reporting users, and managing group recommendations in Discovery.
title: Tinder Launches Group Hangouts, Lets Friends Connect With Other Groups

description: Following the latest price revision, the Xiaomi 17T with 12GB RAM and 256GB storage is priced at Rs. 69,999. The 12GB + 512GB variant now costs Rs. 74,999. Xiaomi 17T was initially introduced in India in June at Rs. 59,999 and Rs. 64,999 for the 256GB and 512GB storage models, respectively. With the latest revision, the handset has become Rs. 10,000 more expensive than its launch price. It is available in Black, Blue, and Violet finishes.
title: Xiaomi 17T Price in India Increased by Rs. 5,000: Here’s How Much It Costs Now

description: Samsung Galaxy Glasses pricing and availability details will be announced in November, according to a report. Apart from this, the Samsung Galaxy Glasses could go on sale in select global markets in November, too, marking Samsung’s entry into a new wearable category. To recap, the Samsung Galaxy Glasses are powered by the Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1 chipset from Qualcomm. The wearable sports a built-in camera, allowing the smart glasses to provide answers to user queries based on visual context. The company says that the smart glasses will deliver up to nine hours of battery life on a single charge. Meanwhile, the wireless charging case will provide up to seven additional full charges.
title: Samsung Galaxy Glasses With Gemini AI to Launch Globally Next Month: Report

description: Poco smartphones will be available at reduced prices during Flipkart's Big Billion Days sale, with discounts spanning the C, M and X series. The Poco X8 Pro Max 5G will be offered in two configurations, while the X8 Pro and X8 Power will also receive price cuts. Buyers can additionally use select bank offers for further savings. The sale begins on October 9 for all customers, with early access for eligible Flipkart members and Credit Card holders starting October 8.
title: Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale: Poco X8 Pro Max, X8, M8x, More Deals Revealed Ahead of Sale

description: Vivo has introduced new RAM and storage configurations for the T5 Lite 5G and T5 Pro 5G in India. They are currently listed on Flipkart with a 'coming soon' tag. The Vivo T5 Lite 5G is now shown in a 4GB RAM and 64GB storage option. The Vivo T5 Pro 5G is shown in a 6GB RAM and 128GB storage configuration. The Vivo T5 Lite 5G runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset. The Vivo T5 Pro 5G runs on a Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset.
title: Vivo T5 Lite 5G, Vivo T5 Pro 5G Get New RAM and Storage Variants in India: Price, Specifications

description: Redmi 17C 5G has been launched in India, the Xiaomi sub-brand announced on Thursday. The Redmi 17C 5G is offered in Coffee Brew, Dark Night, and Purple Dawn colourways. The phone sports a 6.9-inch HD+ (720 x 1,600 pixels) LCD touchscreen. It delivers up to a 120Hz screen refresh rate, up to 810 nits brightness in HBM, up to a 240Hz touch sampling rate, 16.7 million colours, and 83 percent NTSC coverage. Powering the Redmi 17C 5G is an octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, delivering a peak clock speed of up to 2.4GHz. The Redmi 17C 5G packs a 6,000mAh battery with 33W wired fast charging support.
title: Redmi 17C 5G Launched in India With 6,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Airbnb will soon bring new features to its platform via an update scheduled for the end of this year. The fall update will reportedly add a new social feature that lets users interact with others, while Travel Maps brings interactive local maps with reviews, favourites and more.
title: Airbnb’s New Fall Update Adds Travel Map, AI Search, Social Features and More

description: Naughty Dog is reportedly working on an all-new Uncharted game. According to a report, the game will see the return of Nathan Drake, either as a protagonist or as a side character. The project is reportedly being directed by Shaun Escayag, the director of Uncharted: Lost Legacy. The new Uncharted game will reportedly be Naughty Dog's next release after Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet.
title: New Uncharted Game Reportedly in Development at Naughty Dog, Launch Planned After Intergalactic

description: Amazon has revealed the deal prices of Samsung smartphones ahead of the Great Indian Festival sale. The listed models include budget and mid-range Galaxy M series phones. Samsung's foldable smartphones are also confirmed to get discounts in the sale. The sale will begin on October 8. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 is teased to be available for Rs. 1,72,999, instead of the original price of Rs. 179,999.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Samsung Galaxy M17e, Galaxy Z Fold 8 and More to Get Discounts

description: Apple will launch its first smart home hub device on October 13, according to a report. The device will reportedly be launched along with the HomePod Mini (2026) and the Apple TV 4K (2026). Recently, a report highlighted that the home hub will feature a round base attached to a 6-inch or 7-inch square-shaped touchscreen. The Apple Silicon A18 chipset is expected to power the rumoured smart home device. On the other hand, the Apple 4K TV (2026) is said to get the chip and Siri AI upgrade. Moreover, the smart home hub is said to ship with support for Siri AI and FaceTime, which hints at a front-facing camera.
title: Apple to Launch Its First Smart Home Hub, HomePod Mini (2026) and More on October 13: Report

description: Apple announced its new Watch Series 12 and Watch Ultra 4 models at a recent launch event. As the devices go on sale globally, the brand has shared new details on how two upcoming audio intelligence features will work. Apple has announced that Live Rewind and Siri Recap will be available in beta later this year.
title: Apple Watch Series 12, Watch Ultra 4 to Get Siri Recap and Live Rewind Later This Year: All You Need to Know

description: Samsung has launched the Galaxy SmartTag 3 as its latest item tracker. The new device supports iPhone users. The Galaxy SmartTag 3 is rated to deliver up to 550 days of battery life under typical usage. In Power Saving Mode, it can extend battery life up to 790 days. The Galaxy SmartTag 3 will go on sale in South Korea on October 7, followed by a US launch. The company is expected to introduce the tracker in additional markets during 2027. It comes in White and Black colour options.
title: Samsung Galaxy SmartTag 3 Launched With iPhone Support, Up to 790 Days of Battery Life

description: Amazon has introduced a new Fire TV Stick 4K with a quad-core processor, 8GB storage and Wi-Fi 6 connectivity. The streaming device runs on Vega OS and supports 4K video at up to 60fps, while Alexa+ and the redesigned Fire TV interface come built in. Amazon has also updated the Fire TV Remote with tactile controls and a customisable button. The company is simplifying its Fire TV Stick portfolio, while a new Fire TV Remote Plus is planned for 2027.
title: Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K (2026) Launched With Slimmer Build, Redesigned Remote: Price, Features

description: Bitcoin is holding above $84,000 after briefly moving past $85,000, with softer August PCE data reducing expectations of an October Federal Reserve rate hike. Whale accumulation and a firm technical structure are supporting the market, while weaker speculative futures demand and elevated Treasury yields could limit the recovery.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $84,000 as Whales Accumulate Despite Mixed Momentum

description: OnePlus 16 scored 56,33,288 points on the AnTuTu benchmarking platform in the company's internal testing, the tech firm announced on Wednesday. Recently, a report highlighted that the OnePlus 16, with the model number PYB110, has been spotted on the AnTuTu benchmarking platform with an overall score of 53,84,433. Moreover, the tech firm claims that the OnePlus 16 will be launched with the next-generation Wind Chaser Gaming Kernel, which is claimed to allow the phone to run native 185 fps games. Apart from this, the handset will feature the new proprietary Esports Tri-Core, comprising Oppo’s P4 Super Display Chip, Lingxi Touch Chip, and G3 Esports Network Chip.
title: OnePlus 16 Scores Higher on AnTuTu in Firm’s Internal Testing Than Previously Anticipated; New Gaming Features Revealed

description: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA), chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, has approved Delhi Police’s Intelligent Traffic Management System (ITMS) project with a budget outlay of Rs. 1,789.52 crore. As part of the ITMS project, Delhi Police will deploy 1,092 Adaptive Traffic Control Systems across 1,029 enforcement locations. The project will be implemented via a Master System Integrator. The Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC), under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), will provide technical support. Further, ITMS will prioritise the movement of Ambulances and other emergency vehicles and create green corridors for their movement.
title: From Wrong-Way Driving to Mobile Phones: How AI Will Now Catch Traffic Violations in Delhi
